describe: new galvanised steel W-beam crash barrier section, 4 m long: a narrow bright silver-grey steel beam runs the whole length along the bottom edge, its corrugated profile showing as two thin parallel ridges along it; just behind it two small square steel posts, each with a short spacer block joining it to the beam, one a quarter of the way in from each end; both ends cut straight and square, the beam reaching right to them, so sections join end to end
